smallest_supported_claim: In the bound native run, all three materialized R-031 actors accepted the free-text follow request and produced native replies/begins-following messages, but the competing camp-guard ownership remained authoritative: after the follow_close/hold_position sequence, each actor was back in GUARD_ALLY with a guard_post and none pursued the avatar across six westward squares.
causal_account: The native prompt receipt was accepted. The world message surface recorded the three R-031 replies and begins-following transitions. Subsequent actor-bound inspections showed GUARD_ALLY and guard posts for characters 18, 19, and 20; the final native movement reached [3368,995,0] while the actors remained at [3374,994,0], [3376,994,0], and [3376,995,0]. This establishes a transient follow intent overridden/restored by camp guard ownership, not absence of actor materialization.

contradictions: The LLM/native speech path emits begins-following messages, but the follow intent does not persist for these camp-guard actors once hold_position restores GUARD_ALLY and guard_post ownership.
remaining_unknowns: This run does not establish behavior for camp actors without hold_position restoration, nor persistence across save/reload.
The runner response is corroborating application evidence; native actor state and movement are authoritative.
